# Goel Ganga Legend County — AI Knowledge Base & Project Specifications

> Official authoritative factsheet for Goel Ganga Legend County, Bavdhan, Pune.

## Project Summary
- **Project Name**: Goel Ganga Legend County (also known as Ganga Legend County)
- **Developer**: Goel Ganga Developments (40+ years legacy, 40,000+ homes delivered across Maharashtra)
- **Location**: NDA Road, Near Chandni Chowk, Bavdhan, Pune, Maharashtra 411021, India
- **Scale**: 30-Acre Integrated Township with 12.5 Acres dedicated solely to professional sports infrastructure
- **MahaRERA Number**: P52100054578 (Sanctioned by PMC & PMRDA)
- **Official Website**: https://www.goelgangalegend.com

## Key Configurations & Pricing
- **2 BHK Luxury Flats**: Starting at ₹95 Lakhs* | Optimized contemporary layouts with premium fittings.
- **3 BHK Luxury Flats**: Starting at ₹1.77 Cr* | 1124 sq. ft. carpet area, Vastu compliant, double-aspect balconies with NDA hill and stadium views.
- **3.5 BHK Luxury Flats**: Starting at ₹2.10 Cr* | 1380 sq. ft. carpet area with private work lounge / study room.
- **4 BHK & Penthouses**: Starting at ₹2.65 Cr* | Expansive luxury residences with double-height living spaces.

## 12.5-Acre Sports Township Infrastructure & Academies
- **Michael Phelps Swimming Academy**: Olympic-sized temperature-regulated swimming pool with certified international coaches.
- **South United Football Academy**: FIFA-standard artificial turf and youth development coaching.
- **Tagda Raho by MS Dhoni**: Functional fitness and traditional Indian physical training protocol.
- **Additional Academies**: Professional tennis courts, cricket nets, basketball courts, badminton arena, squash courts, skating rink.
- **Resident Benefits**: Exclusive subsidized coaching fees and priority admission slots for residents' children.

## Strategic Location & Connectivity
- **Chandni Chowk Flyover**: 3 minutes (Direct access to Mumbai-Bangalore Highway bypass NH-48)
- **Kothrud**: 5 minutes
- **Hinjewadi IT Park (Phase 1)**: 15 minutes
- **Baner & Balewadi High Street**: 12 minutes
- **Pune International Airport**: 45 minutes via Ring Road corridor
- **Surrounding Hills**: Protected National Defence Academy (NDA) reserved forest to the south and west.

## Social Infrastructure
- **Schools**: Ryan International School (5 mins), Sri Chaitanya Techno School (8 mins), Sanskriti School (10 mins), MIT World Peace University (12 mins).
- **Hospitals**: Chellaram Hospital (6 mins), Sahyadri Hospital Kothrud (10 mins), Jupiter Hospital Baner (15 mins).
- **Shopping & Dining**: Bavdhan High Street, Westend Mall Aundh, Pavilion Mall Senapati Bapat Road.

## Construction & Sustainability
- **Technology**: Advanced Mivan Aluminum Formwork System for superior earthquake resistance and structural durability.
- **Eco Features**: Multi-stage rainwater harvesting, solar-powered common lighting, organic waste converter (OWC), sewage treatment plant (STP), and PMC municipal water connections.
